run_predict_future: run the Kronos prediction script for a given A-share stock symbol via CLI
create_load_data: create a function that fetches and cleans daily A-share K-line data from akshare for a stock symbol
build_prepare_inputs: build a function that slices the last 400 rows of OHLCV data and generates prediction timestamp ranges
test_apply_price_limits: test the price-limiting function that clips predicted values to within ±10% of the last close price
summarize_plot_result: summarize the plotting function that renders historical and predicted close prices as a line chart
